title: Unable to navigate using link or router.push in not-found.js template (next.js 13.4)

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: win32
      Arch: x64
      Version: Windows 10 Home Single Language
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.12.1
      npm: N/A
      Yarn: N/A
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.4.2
      eslint-config-next: 13.4.2
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 5.0.
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

App directory (appDir: true), Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/sanskar-19/nextjs-app-bugs

### To Reproduce

1. Go to homepage
2. Click on Go to random
3. You will notice its not redirecting to 404 first thing. 
4. If you reload the same then it goes to 404
5. From the 404 page link ain't working back to homepage.

### Describe the Bug

Unable to navigate between routes using Link or router.push()

### Expected Behavior

The pages should navigate easily as expected.

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

Chrome

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

_No response_
